title: LinkedIn posts with links get 13.6% more engagement

hero.caption: more interactions when a link is included
hero.label: more interactions with a link in the post
hero.alt: LinkedIn posts with a link earned 13.6% more interactions than posts without one, per Metricool's analysis of 577,000 posts.

visuals.headline: Links outperformed no-link posts
visuals.source: Source: Metricool, via Search Engine Journal
visuals.alt: Posts with a link earned 13.57% more interactions and 4.90% more views than posts without one. Source: Metricool, via Search Engine Journal.

visuals.after_heading: Why everyone believed links killed reach
visuals.text: Metricool's 577,000-post sample is large enough that the 13.57% gap is unlikely to be noise.
visuals.source: Source: Metricool, via Search Engine Journal
visuals.alt: A sample of 577,000 posts is large enough that a 13.57% engagement gap is unlikely to be noise.

visuals.after_heading: What this means for your posting checklist
visuals.headline: Four changes worth making now
items: Put the link where readers can see it.
Carousels led engagement at 45.85% in the same dataset.
Company page benchmarks will not map exactly to one account.
A short Monday check beats watching engagement rate alone.
visuals.alt: A four-item checklist for posting links on LinkedIn: drop the first-comment default, keep format strategy first, treat benchmarks as directional, review clicks weekly.

visuals.after_heading: How to use links without losing reach
visuals.headline: Four steps before you hit publish

items.title: Lead with the value
items.text: Give the reader a reason to click before the link appears.

items.title: State it in two lines
items.text: Say what the post is about in the first two lines.

items.title: Let the link follow
items.text: Add the link naturally, not as an afterthought.

items.title: Match format to goal
items.text: Reach goals need a carousel or video. A specific action needs a direct link.

visuals.source: Source: Metricool, via Search Engine Journal and Influencer Marketing Hub
visuals.alt: A four-step framework for posting links on LinkedIn: lead with the value, state it in two lines, let the link follow, match format to goal.

visuals.after_heading: What this means for a sales team's weekly routine
visuals.line: Carousels still lead every format measured in Metricool's dataset, ahead of any link post.
visuals.source: Source: Metricool, via Influencer Marketing Hub
visuals.alt: Carousels reached 45.85% engagement, the highest of any format in Metricool's dataset of 577,000 LinkedIn posts.
